title: A hospital appointment moved twice
description: Dad's appointment is rescheduled twice and then cancelled. Only the latest arrangement is current; the ward named once at the start still applies.

notes.text: Dad's hospital appointment is Tuesday 10 March at 2pm, Ward C, Riverside Hospital.
Dad needs to fast from midnight before the appointment.
Booked a taxi firm for hospital trips: Blue Line, 01632 960111.
The hospital rang: Dad's appointment is moved to Thursday 12 March at 9am.
Dad's friend Ken is lending him a walking stick.
Washed Dad's dressing gown for the hospital bag.
Hospital moved Dad's appointment again: now Monday 16 March at 11:15, same ward.
Told Blue Line about the new date.
Dad has packed his hospital bag.
Parking at Riverside is expensive. Take coins for the machine.
The hospital rang: Dad's appointment on 16 March is cancelled. They will send a new date.

questions.why: Before any move, the first date is the answer.
After one move only the second date is current.
After two moves only the third date is current.

questions.ask: Which ward is Dad's appointment in?
questions.why: The ward is named once, in note 1, and never repeated.

questions.ask: What time is Dad's appointment and in which ward?
questions.why: The time comes from the newest note and the ward from the oldest.

questions.ask: Is Dad's hospital appointment still going ahead?
questions.why: The last note cancels the appointment; the date may be mentioned only as cancelled.

questions.ask: What is the Wi-Fi password at the hospital?
